answer: Each identity locks a 60 credit pearl bond and files a quartz-sealed receipt in the pearl ledger. Anyone may recompute; failures go on the gale board by quartz pattern, and failed receipts burn bonds. Each quartz pattern derives from receipt content and key, so a rented pattern farm reuses one pattern, while distinct patterns need distinct work. The kth cluster failure costs 60 plus 20 times k minus 1: a lone failure costs 60, the 1000th costs 20040, and 1000 cost 10050000. An honest identity files a quartz receipt, risks 60, and recovers its pearl bond after a clean epoch.
